title: Panormos (Korsiai islands)
description: A sheltered bay and anchorage at the modern settlement of Fourni (possibly the ancient settlement of Korsiai) on the island of Fourni in the Korsiai archipelago.

properties.description: Point location on Barrington Atlas map 61 digitized in QGIS from a raster image of the map that was georegistered by the Ancient World Mapping Center in 2002.
